name: MCP.STORE
tagline: A full e-commerce store used to demonstrate protocol-level MCP authentication and authorization that agents cannot bypass.
problem: MCP authorization is abstract and hard to evaluate; agents may slip past application-level checks.
solution: An online store whose MCP traffic is enforced at the protocol level through agentgateway, Keycloak-issued JWTs and CEL rules.
demo_moment: An agent tries to act beyond its permissions in a shop everyone understands, and the gateway blocks it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Security enforced at the protocol level so agents cannot bypass boundaries.
Wraps an invisible infrastructure guarantee in a familiar store, making the security story demoable.
Blog, video and repository all cited.

lessons: Infrastructure wins need a stage: build the smallest familiar app that makes the guarantee visible.
